body_markdown:
GARLAND, TX (Sep 2, 2026) — Massimo will show its new Warrior 1500 UTV at Equip Exposition 2026 in Louisville, Kentucky (October 20 to 23) and at the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas (November 3 to 6).


The Warrior 1500 marks Massimo's move into the higher-displacement UTV category. It's built around a new 1,499cc inline four-cylinder platform, with an all-metal body and a focus on recreational, commercial and demanding off-road use.


The same platform will also power the upcoming Sentinel 1500 HVAC Crew, which pairs the extra power with enclosed-cab comfort, heating and air conditioning.


"The Warrior 1500 is more than an important new model for Massimo; we also believe that it represents a milestone in the development of a broader product and engineering platform," said Quenton Petersen, CEO of Massimo Group.
